statement.p: Compute the curl of the vector field \vec F = 4z\,\mathit{\vec i}+5y\,\mathit{\vec j}+7x\,\mathit{\vec k}.

solution.me: \mbox{curl}(4z\,\mathit{\vec i}+5y\,\mathit{\vec j}+7x\,\mathit{\vec k}) = \left| \begin{array}{ccc} \quad\vec i\quad \amp \quad \vec j\quad \amp \quad \vec k\quad \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial y} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\ 4z \amp 5y \amp 7x \end{array} \right| = -3\,\mathit{\vec j}.
